title_en: Ill has lain down Lenche Rzhanova
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. Guessing: 'којничанче' (horseman or horse-dealer), 'дурмаџивче' (my reading: carter), and the last line 'од Милета Алду', which I could not understand and translated literally. 'Р'жаново' is probably a family or place name.

lines.en: Ill has lain down Lenche Rzhanova,
ill has lain down, her head bandaged.

lines.cyr: На глава ѝ стои нејна стара мајка
lines.lat: Na glava ì stoi nejna stara majka
lines.en: At her head stands her old mother

lines.cyr: и на Ленче збори: - Стани Ленче, стани.
lines.lat: i na Lenče zbori: - Stani Lenče, stani.
lines.en: and says to Lenche: - Get up, Lenche, get up.

lines.cyr: Стани Ленче, стани, стројници кај идат,
lines.lat: Stani Lenče, stani, strojnici kaj idat,
lines.en: Get up, Lenche, get up, the matchmakers are coming,
the matchmakers are coming, the ones from Shtip.

lines.cyr: - Јас си сакам мамо либе велешанче,
lines.lat: - Jas si sakam mamo libe velešanče,
lines.en: - I want, mother, a sweetheart from Veles,
a sweetheart from Veles, a young horseman,
a young horseman, a young carter.

lines.cyr: Како дошле, мајко, така да си одат,
lines.lat: Kako došle, majko, taka da si odat,
lines.en: As they came, mother, so let them go,

lines.cyr: кога не се мајко од Милета Алду!
lines.lat: koga ne se majko od Mileta Aldu!
lines.en: since they are not, mother, from Mile's Aldo.
